משמש כמפתח חיפוש (CustomerAccountProgramPa) ב-Lookup "Lookup Match PowerOfAttorney By CustomerAccount Or CustomerProgram"
ערך מוחזר מ-Lookup "Lookup Match PowerOfAttorney By CustomerAccount Or CustomerProgram" (עמודה PowerOfAttorneyIdPa מנתוני ה-CRM/DB)
מזהה את הרשומה שמתעדכנת (מפתח רשומה "PowerOfAttorneyIdPa" ברכיב "Update NeedToSendMailBit")
הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: The written value is CASE over the target row's own Gen_appendixtype (2/3/5 -> 1, else 0), evaluated inside the UPDATE statement (DTSX:6661-6667)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: PowerOfAttorneyIdPa returned by the lookup is the WHERE key (Param_0) - the active POA on the same customer account/program as the waiting POA (Lookup SqlCommand DTSX:5543-5550, ParameterMap DTSX:5567; SqlCommand '?' DTSX:6668)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: Lookup join: waiting POA isnull(Gen_CustomerAccount, gen_customerprogram) = active POA isnull(Gen_CustomerAccount, gen_customerprogram) (Get Waiting Poa DTSX:5378-5418 (CustomerAccountProgram); Lookup DTSX:5543-5567)
הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: Source WHERE poa.Gen_startdate <= GETDATE() and poa.Gen_currentstate = 3 (DTSX:5378-5418)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: Source WHERE agentcyIdNumber NOT IN (6 hard-coded agency numbers) and Is Renewal: only rows where agentcyIdNumberPa == agentcyIdNumber is not true reach the UPDATE (DTSX:5378-5418, 5518-5521)

הוצהר ע"י האנליסט: Is Renewal condition agentcyIdNumberPa == agentcyIdNumber (same agent/agency = renewal -> no update); NULL -> FailComponent (hypothesis per SSIS semantics) (DTSX:5543-5550, 5518-5521)

rowFilters.component: Lookup Match PowerOfAttorney By CustomerAccount Or CustomerProgram

targets.recordKey: WHERE Gen_powerofattorneyId = ? (the only '?' in the SQL, DTSX:6668 -> Param_0 = input column PowerOfAttorneyIdPa, DTSX:6677/6680). PowerOfAttorneyIdPa is returned by Lookup 'Match PowerOfAttorney By CustomerAccount Or CustomerProgram' = pa.Gen_powerofattorneyId of an ACTIVE POA (pa.Gen_currentstate = 1) whose isnull(Gen_CustomerAccount, gen_customerprogram) equals CustomerAccountProgram = isnull(poa.Gen_CustomerAccount, gen_customerprogram) of the WAITING POA - i.e. the existing active POA is updated, not the waiting one.
targets.writeCondition: Rows come from 'Get Waiting Poa' (Gen_powerofattorney WHERE Gen_startdate <= GETDATE() AND Gen_currentstate = 3, and agentcyIdNumber = isnull(Contact.Gen_Identitynumber, Account.AccountNumber) NOT IN ('515092484','513334151','513173393','513173493','514979715','515462380') - this NOT IN also removes rows with NULL agentcyIdNumber; DTSX:5378-5418). Only rows for which the Lookup finds an active POA on the same customer account/program (Match; No Match goes to Union All, DTSX path 'Lookup No Match Output') and for which 'Is Renewal' (agentcyIdNumberPa == agentcyIdNumber, DTSX:5518-5521) is not true -> 'Not Renewal' output -> this command. 'Is Renewal' Renewal output has errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:5518): a NULL agentcyIdNumberPa (active POA without agent/agency id) makes the condition NULL -> component and data flow fail (hypothesis per SSIS semantics). Full-cache lookup (CacheType=0, DTSX:5561): if several active POAs share the customer account/program only one (the first cached) is matched. Command input errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:6675): an SQL error fails the data flow.
targets.expression: SET gen_iscancellationemailrequired = CASE WHEN Gen_appendixtype = 2 THEN 1 WHEN Gen_appendixtype = 3 THEN 1 WHEN Gen_appendixtype = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END. No input column carries the value: it is computed inside the UPDATE from the TARGET row's own Gen_powerofattorneyBase.Gen_appendixtype (the old active POA), not from the waiting POA's gen_appendixtype. Result is 1 for appendix type 2/3/5, otherwise 0 (also 0 when Gen_appendixtype is NULL, via ELSE).
targets.attrCondition: Value 1 or 0 decided by the target row's Gen_appendixtype; the row is updated only when reached via Lookup Match + 'Not Renewal' (see write condition)

notes.note: Writers in lineage (2): 1 business CRM write mapped here (Update NeedToSendMailBit, 1 attribute). Excluded as ETL plumbing: End ETL Process Record\ETL Record Finish (updates gen_etlprocess, main.cs:44-52). Also plumbing (control flow): Create ETL Process Record (gen_etlprocess create, ScriptMain.cs:99-104), Write To ETLProcessCounter End (gen_etlprocesscounter create, ScriptMain.cs:53-64), Get Organization Variables, Get Valid Optionsets Values / Set Queue Id Variable (read-only scripts: no Create/Update/Execute calls in their code).

Unlike 0031_PoaAccountUpdateDaily, this Test package does NOT change the waiting POA's state in CRM: Handle Wait Status - For Active only writes the old active POA's gen_iscancellationemailrequired (direct SQL) and rows to GENERIX_STAGING.dbo.PowerOfAttorneySendEmails (staging, not CRM). Handle Active Status - For Cancel only reads CRM (Get Active Poa, Get Agency lookup) and writes to the same staging table - no CRM write in that flow. The 0031 component of the same name instead sets gen_receivingdateofcancelpoa with two parameters; here the SQL is different (one '?', sets gen_iscancellationemailrequired).

The flag written here (gen_iscancellationemailrequired) is read back in this package by 'Handle Active Status - For Cancel\Get Active Poa' (poa.gen_iscancellationemailrequired, DTSX:4194) and used by 'Is Need To Send Cancellation Mail' (!ISNULL(gen_iscancellationemailrequired) && gen_iscancellationemailrequired == TRUE, DTSX:4408-4421) to route rows to the staging e-mail table - i.e. it only influences staging output in this package.

Direct UPDATE on Gen_powerofattorneyBase bypasses CRM SDK (no plugins/workflows/auditing, modifiedon not set) - Unsupported per CLAUDE.md rule 9; [CRM] connection = psql / Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM (DTSX:4).

Several waiting POAs on the same customer account/program map to the same active POA and each executes the same UPDATE; since the value depends only on the target row's Gen_appendixtype, the result is identical regardless of order.
